title: Preserve the first HTTP-200 packet across reruns.
comment:
**Preserve the first HTTP-200 packet across reruns.**

If an operator reruns a route after a later packet fails, `evaluate_route` sends every earlier packet again. It then overwrites each packet’s saved request and response (`scripts/eval_judge_contract.py`, Lines 235 and 258). This contradicts the stated first-HTTP-200 rule and can discard the original evaluation evidence. Resume from saved packet status and leave completed responses unchanged.

title: Implement the documented transport retry.
comment:
**Implement the documented transport retry.**

If a live request raises `requests.RequestException`, `evaluate_route` stops the route after one attempt (`scripts/eval_judge_contract.py`, Lines 275-277). It does not retry with the new timeout. A transient failure therefore leaves later packets unevaluated. Retry the failed packet, record each attempt, and make the HTTP-error policy explicit. Update the HTTP 503 test fixture so it can exercise the retry.
